[
  "When melanoma is suspected, the entire lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1-3 mm) margin to allow histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large melanoma lesions located on the face, such as lentigo maligna, as well as on acral lesions and genital lesions.",
  "The recommendation that the entire lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1-3 mm) margin has a consensus rate of 100% (21/21) according to eado:pmid:39709737:recommendation-1.",
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first-line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness.",
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is also the recommended first-line treatment for melanoma in situ.",
  "Surgical margins should be based on tumor thickness according to aad:pmid:30392755:table-x-excision-first-line.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed in the same operative setting as the wide excision whenever possible according to aad:pmid:30392755:table-x-slnb-timing."
]
